answer: Sybil keys are cheap, so voting weight accrues only after a live check. At epoch open a public randomness beacon publishes a salt no applicant can precompute. Each claimant carries that salt into a personal forge: a one-shot prover that binds a timed work transcript to one key and a fresh nonce. The ticket is non-transferable. The scarce attendance drip, nectar, is paid only against a unique valid ticket; colliding transcripts under the same salt slash both bonds and zero the drip. A farm must keep every alias uniquely forging under the live salt, which costs more than the drip returns.
